title: Celeste
originalLaunchPlatform: Nintendo Switch / PlayStation 4 / Xbox One / PC
shortDescription: Maddy Thorson and Noel Berry's transcendent precision platformer, following Madeline's mountain-climbing journey through panic and self-acceptance.
historicalSignificance: Celebrated as the definitive modern 2D precision platformer, merging pixel-perfect air-dash movement with an emotionally profound examination of anxiety and depression, winning Best Independent Game at The Game Awards 2018.

editorialContent.overview: Young woman Madeline resolves to climb the mystical Celeste Mountain to confront her internal self-doubt and panic attacks, encountering a physical manifestation of her darker impulses known as 'Part of Me'.
editorialContent.gameplay: Masterfully tuned movement mechanics centered around jump, wall-climb, and an 8-directional air dash, featuring instant respawns across hundreds of handcrafted screen-sized challenges.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Engineered with subtle 'coyote time' and jump buffering forgiving micro-imperfections, paired with Lena Raine's critically acclaimed piano and synth electronic soundtrack.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Became an inspiring touchstone for queer and mental health themes in gaming, praised for its compassionate philosophy that self-love requires accepting one's struggles.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on physical Nintendo Switch and PS4 cartridges/discs via Limited Run Games.

awards: The Game Awards Best Independent Game 2018
D.I.C.E. Action Game of the Year

technicalSpecs.resolution: 320 x 180 native pixel art scaled to 1080p/4K
technicalSpecs.soundChip: Lena Raine dynamic electronic acoustic score
